## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue when available.

## Validation

- [ ] Extension tests pass (`bun test scripts/` in `apps/extension`).
- [ ] TypeScript passes (`bun run compile` in `apps/extension`).
- [ ] Chrome production build passes (`bun run build` in `apps/extension`).
- [ ] Relevant behavior, keyboard access and reduced motion have been checked.
- [ ] Generated outputs, local state and secrets are excluded.

## Review

List any remaining limitations and dependent branches. UI changes include a screenshot or recording when available. Merge requires the maintainer's explicit approval of the reviewed changes. Releases are separate from routine fixes.
